title: Evaluating retrieval quality
summary: An unpublished lesson to demonstrate the editorial workflow.

title: What connects the Learning Journey and Resource Library?
question: What connects the Learning Journey and Resource Library?
answer: They open the same canonical lesson. Completion and saved state stay consistent.

title: A colleague opens a lesson from search. Where should their progress appear?
question: A colleague opens a lesson from search. Where should their progress appear?
answer: Their completion should update the same lesson in the guided journey.

title: Spot the flaw: each track stores a separate copy of the same lesson.
question: Spot the flaw: each track stores a separate copy of the same lesson.
answer: Duplicated lessons can drift apart. A shared lesson ID keeps material and progress consistent.

title: Which action should make a draft lesson visible to learners?
question: Which action should make a draft lesson visible to learners?
answer: Publishing makes it available, provided its parent hierarchy is also published.

title: Put the learning hierarchy in order.
question: Put the learning hierarchy in order.
answer: Start with a track, then a main concept, a topic, and finally a lesson.
